The chronicity, atrophy/scarring and perianal involvement point away from simple contact dermatitis, tinea, or vitiligo and suggest a sclerosing vulvar dermatosis. DIAGNOSIS: Vulvar lichen sclerosus (lichen sclerosus et atrophicus of the vulva).
